modalLead: Small fixes on top of v2026.09.09. Recorded here but not announced: v2026.09.09 is the release worth reading, and this does not displace it.

items.text: Page tabs are big enough to tap. On a tablet — a touch device wide enough to keep the desktop layout — the tabs measured 28×33, under the 44px iOS and Android ask for.
A page tab names itself. With page names switched off the tab read as a bare number to a screen reader; it now carries the page's own name.
The bulk enable buttons say which rows they act on. Monitor these 3 sat directly above 2 selected with nothing saying which set each meant — they read Monitor all 3 shown now.
